title: Alex Delamaire - Guiding & Evaluating New IP - A Toolbox
description:
Alex Delamaire - Guiding & Evaluating New IP - A Toolbox

“Culture is a moving target”, as the adage says. So how do you build something today that may still resonate with players tomorrow? And why would you even consider taking that risk if you have the option to leverage an already established IP and audience? To help you find your answers to those questions, let’s examine various frameworks and tools to reduce uncertainty; revisit advice from talented devs that bear repeating; and look at BBI’s original IP incubation process.
